kinematic_attachment.replacement_policy: A held tool or replacement effector requires a new profile revision with its own qualified terminal-joint-to-controlled-frame geometry. Do not inherit the bare-gripper attachment implicitly.

capture_motion_policy.policy_note: The DM arm joint-state and FK transform timestamps describe the estimated measured-joint acquisition interval, with uncertainty reported in data.feedback_timing. The host therefore does not add feedback age to those timestamps. Another arm or effector profile must declare its own timestamp semantics explicitly.

landmark_fallback_policy.no_hardware_modification_strategy: Prefer a qualified rigid proximal feature with reliable same-surface depth, such as the neon-green Rail-Bracket, when the controlled tip or attached tool is reflective or occluded.
landmark_fallback_policy.optional_physical_fiducial_policy: A non-reflective ball may be added in a separately revised profile, but baseline operation must not require that modification.

visual_alignment_landmarks.description_for_vlm: Locate the foremost physical peak of each bare gripper jaw. Select the named peak in RGB, then independently select a valid registered-depth pixel on the same physical jaw-tip surface. Do not select the work object, background, highlight, or nearest unrelated foreground.

visibility.material_note: Jaw peaks may be reflective or lack exact depth.

visual_alignment_landmarks.description_for_vlm: Always locate the two opposite lateral terminal-face centers of the rigid neon-green gripper Rail-Bracket, then use their mean as the observed rail center. Select the neon-green rail endpoints, not either jaw tip, not the space between the jaws, and not any work object. For each endpoint, select the physical feature in RGB and a valid registered-depth pixel on that same terminal face, slightly inside the silhouette rather than on a mixed foreground-background edge. Do not move either selection toward the gripper tip; the effector profile applies the measured rail-center-to-tip offset deterministically.

tool_point_binding.measurement_note: The measured vector from the neon-green rail center to the controller IK/FK tip is +80 mm along the controlled/final-joint +X axis. The solver consumes the inverse vector from the controlled-frame origin to the observed rail center, which is -80 mm on controlled-frame X.

visibility.material_note: The physical Rail-Bracket is strongly visible neon green; the retained CAD atlas uses neutral blue-grey rendering.

action_frames.note: The controller IK/FK point remains the gripper-tip pair mean. Visual refinement observes the neon-green rail center by default, then applies the user-measured rail-center-to-tip vector [+0.080, 0, 0] m along controlled-frame +X; equivalently, the rail center is [-0.080, 0, 0] m in controlled-frame coordinates.

invalidation_conditions: Tool slip or a changed held-tool assembly
Camera calibration or stationary mounting identity change
A required runtime landmark binding becomes unavailable
